title: spaex Install Lockfile v4 (npm/pip-shape simplification)
description: Schema for `.spaex/install.lock`. Retired generated_by, constitution, atoms, contributed_paths, generation_inputs, participating_roots, and visibility_marker fields remain rejected by the schema. Spec 027 adds the optional top-level `content_hashes` field; every other retired-field behavior is unchanged.

generation_id.description: This generation's identifier. install.lock is the sole publication record; there is no separate visibility.json file.

molecules.$comment: The post-schema semantic validator requires lexicographic (id, source, revision, paths) ordering. JSON Schema cannot compare properties across array items. uniqueItems rejects duplicate full tuples.
molecules.description: One entry per resolved molecule, canonically ordered by (id, source, revision, paths). Constitution provenance, participating roots, and tool/adapter identity are all derivable from this array rather than tracked separately.

content_hashes.description: Spec 027: sha256 of the content spaex last wrote for a subset of paths recorded somewhere in `molecules[].paths` (currently: exclusive generic-atom root files only). Used solely to detect operator modification since install (FR-007) before `spaex remove` deletes or regenerates a path; absent for any path this generation did not write itself, and never required to cover every recorded path. Optional; omitted when no generic-atom category is in use.

revision.description: Immutable full commit SHA per Constitution Principle IV.

items.$comment: Spec 027: the second anyOf branch admits a bare repo-root-relative filename (no leading dot-segment) for exclusive generic-atom entries (e.g. flake.nix, .envrc, .gitignore) — syntactic widening only; nothing here restricts the branch to any particular category, since paths carries no category field to key off (see data-model.md InstallLock extension). The original dot-segment-required branch is unchanged and remains the only accepted shape for behavior/skill/skills and composable-category (.spaex/generated/...) entries.

paths.description: Unique, deterministically ordered POSIX paths relative to the consumer repository root that this molecule wrote or contributed. Behavior molecules list the shared .spaex/constitution.md publication path. A path under a leading dot-segment implicitly names its participating root; a bare filename (Spec 027) has no such root and is understood to live at the literal repository root instead.

hook_status.description: Outcome of this molecule's install_hook invocation for the current generation. Present ONLY when the pinned molecule manifest declared install_hook. 'ok' = hook was enabled and exited 0. 'failed' = hook could not be launched, violated cache containment, or exited non-zero under on_failure='warn'. 'skipped' = operator supplied --no-install-hooks. A hook failure under on_failure='abort' produces no record because the entire generation rolls back.

speckit.description: Successful Spec Kit integration selection and outcomes for this molecule.
